text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Just as we were about to head back
from our outing with Taiki Shuttle—

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Trainer, today was so much fun to—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...It seems to be a passing shower.
Let's hurry and move under shelter—

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha. We don't have an umbrella right now anyway!
Let's just enjoy the rain instead!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Running in the rain feels absolutely wonderful, YES!
It is totally different from a pool! Like the sensation of running through water!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
No problem! I'm totally fine!!
I never catch colds!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Whoo~!! Splaaash!!
Bring on the rain, more and more!
choice_data_list: If it's come to this, then by brute force...!
Then let's race to the station!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Oh! Trainer.
Is that a fighting pose!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Still, I was no match for Taiki Shuttle's power,
and ended up getting pelted by the rain for a while...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Later on, Taiki Shuttle came to the academy full of energy.
...Unlike me, who had caught a cold.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And with that, Taiki Shuttle dashed
cheerfully into the sheltered building.
